mechanisms.name: The plan over-counts
mechanisms.stated: 69000 split was 12079 present + 56921 absent. Either that sum is not the plan, or the plan counts a class the writer never emits.
mechanisms.note: 12079+56921=69000 is already true from the close numbers. skippedUnusableKey is outside planned[]. Will confirm the writer emits both present and absent (it does: buildAtomForPlannedWellFact both arms) before rejecting.

mechanisms.name: The writer skips a class silently
mechanisms.stated: Parcels declined without a recorded refusal. Defect twice: rows missing and nothing named them.
mechanisms.note: Unusable keys and duplicate parcelKeys are skipped before planned[] is built. They cannot subtract from a 69000 that was already built and counted as atomsWritten. A silent skip AFTER build would. Will look at assertCanonicalParcelEntityId / assertScopeOnAtoms / assertPropertyWriteBoundary as refuse-not-skip.

mechanisms.name: The batch drops rows
mechanisms.stated: Chunk boundaries, upsert conflict collapsing two planned rows onto one atom_did, or a slice that partially failed without failing the run. Durable: merged data, recurs on every county.
mechanisms.why_first: Job reported atomsWritten=69000 and verified=69000 and exit 0 while store unique PKs=66913. That is the signature of last-wins upsert on a colliding atom_did: slice.length is counted, verify reads the surviving body, unique PKs shrink. writePropertyAtomsBatch:298-307 and write-well-fact-county.mjs:341-344. Next: derive entityId/atomDid and find the collision class whose multiplicity is 2087.

mechanisms.name: The count is right and the plan is a different population
mechanisms.stated: Present-plus-absent may not be the writable set.
mechanisms.note: atomsBuilt is a 1:1 map of planned[]. Writable set equals planned set unless a persist assertion drops a class. Will reject if entityId construction is defined for every planned row and the persist path has no filter, only upsert.
